🖼️ JPEG XL: The modern image format is now supported by all major browsers, with Firefox 158 the latest to enable it by default. Jake Archibald pits it against AVIF in this extensive review. What I find amazing is what it's able to render in under 100 bytes.

📍 Maplair: A Batteries-Included, Tree-Shakeable Fork of Leaflet Still in alpha since last year, one of Leaflet's contributors has forked it, rolling in the 2.0 work plus rotation, fullscreen, search, heatmaps and more – all tree-shakeable. Simon Legner

👀 tsrs: Cloudflare and VoidZero's Rust Port of TypeScript A Rust port of the Go-based TypeScript 7 compiler, built with some input from the TypeScript team and heading into Oxc. Benchmarks claim up to 8x the speed of TypeScript 7.0 and it runs in WebAssembly. Experimental, but npx tsrs works. Chen, Mitropoulos and Nakazawa (Cloudflare / VoidZero)
